query_precision: Lossless IEEE754 float64, little endian, C order.
temporal_mean: Each concentration record is an hourly mean; queries select its original reporting interval.
no_ppb_reason: This product has concentration only; no unstated fixed-temperature conversion is applied.
deposition_time_semantics: Native cumulative endpoints since forecast initialization; frame h is report-end h+1. Subtract the actual lead10 baseline for the reporting period. Never sum cumulative snapshots.

source_evidence.meaning: The writer multiplies kilogram-grid-mass by1e12 per area, so numeric values are nanograms/m2 although the attribute says picograms/m2.

deposition_unit_interpretation.snapshot_semantics: Cumulative since simulation initialization for this nonradioactiveSO2; report-period accumulation must subtract the actual lead10 baseline, not sum snapshots.
deposition_unit_interpretation.raw_data_policy: Retain original NC/SHA and its original unit label; correct derived presentation metadata with explicit provenance, never rescale the underlying numeric field.
deposition_unit_interpretation.scope_limit: This verifies output-unit interpretation, not whole370h qualification or atmospheric truth.
